controls.regle: A minimal tag taxonomy (application, environment, domain, owner) is defined, published, and applied from the creation of any billable resource.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a published tag taxonomy (mandatory keys) and the application of a creation-time control (policy) preventing the provisioning of non-compliant resources.
controls.preuve_attendue: Reference to the published tag taxonomy + configuration of the creation-time control policy.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = taxonomy published + active blocking control at creation ; partial = taxonomy published without automated control ; non-compliant = absence of taxonomy observed
actions_audit: Request the published tag taxonomy (mandatory keys); attach the reference.
Provision a non-compliant test resource and verify the blocking by the policy; document the result.
If a gap is found: publish the taxonomy and activate the blocking control at creation.

controls.regle: The tagging compliance rate of the resource portfolio is measured periodically, with an automatic alert on any non-compliant resource detected.
controls.verification: Run or review the latest tagging compliance report; verify the compliance rate obtained and the presence of an active alert on non-compliant resources.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated tagging compliance report with measured rate and list of non-compliant resources.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = ≥ 98% compliance and active alert ; partial = measurement available without automated alert ; non-compliant = no compliance measurement available
actions_audit: Extract the latest tagging compliance report for the portfolio; attach the observed rate.
Verify the alert configuration for non-compliant resources; document its activation.
If a gap is found: implement the missing periodic measurement and alert.

controls.regle: Every billable resource carries an application tag unambiguously resolved in the service registry, enabling cost tracking by application and by business unit without manual reconstruction.
controls.verification: Verify that all resources carry a valid application tag resolved in the service registry (CMDB) and that cost can be broken down by application/business unit without manual investigation.
controls.preuve_attendue: Application tag ↔ service registry reconciliation report + example of cost breakdown by application.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = 100% resolution and automated breakdown by business unit ; partial = documented manual resolution for gaps ; non-compliant = orphaned resources not detected
actions_audit: Extract the reconciliation report between application tags and the service registry; attach the resolution rate.
Simulate resolving an incident from an isolated resource to the owning application; time and document it.
If a gap is found: fix the orphaned resources and automate the periodic reconciliation.

controls.regle: A budget is declared for each significant scope (application, environment), with an automatic drift alert at progressive thresholds (e.g., 50%/80%/100%).
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a declared budget for each significant scope and the effective configuration of drift alerts at multiple progressive thresholds.
controls.preuve_attendue: Budget and alert configuration + alert trigger history.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = budget covering all significant scopes + active multi-threshold alerts ; partial = partial budget or single-threshold alert ; non-compliant = absence of a declared budget
actions_audit: Inventory the budgets declared per significant scope; attach the configuration.
Verify the effective triggering of alerts at progressive thresholds (history); document the result.
If a gap is found: declare the missing budgets and configure the multi-threshold alerts.

controls.regle: A periodic FinOps review is held, with a dated report and recorded arbitration decisions.
controls.verification: Request the reports of the latest FinOps reviews; verify their regularity and the presence of recorded decisions, beyond a simple dashboard review.
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated report of the latest FinOps review + recurring review schedule.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = regular review tracked with recorded decisions ; partial = irregular review or without recorded decisions ; non-compliant = no FinOps review observed
actions_audit: Request the reports of the latest FinOps reviews and their schedule; attach the documents.
Verify the presence of recorded arbitration decisions in the reports; document the finding.
If a gap is found: establish the missing review cadence and decision-report format.

controls.regle: The current operating cost is known, broken down by resource and by service, and a cost projection at target scale (volume, users) is documented with explicit calculation assumptions.
controls.verification: Verify the export of costs for the last 30-90 days broken down by resource/service and the existence of a quantified projection at target with explicit assumptions (users, requests/day, volume).
controls.preuve_attendue: Broken-down cost export + target projection document with calculation assumptions.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = cost known and broken down + documented quantified projection ; partial = cost known without projection (or projection without breakdown) ; non-compliant = cost not measured
actions_audit: Extract the cost export for the last 30-90 days broken down by resource/service; attach the export.
Request the target projection document and verify that the calculation assumptions are made explicit; document the finding.
If a gap is found: produce the missing breakdown and/or projection.

controls.regle: Relevant cost optimizations are identified, quantified, and prioritized in an action plan: routing to a cost-effective model based on complexity, semantic caching, and context compression for AI inference costs; sizing, reservation, or scheduled shutdown for other resources.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a quantified optimization plan (estimated gain, effort) covering both traditional infrastructure costs and, where applicable, AI inference costs (model routing, semantic caching, prompt compression).
controls.preuve_attendue: Dated optimization plan with estimated gains and implementation status.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = quantified optimization plan partially implemented ; partial = optimizations identified but not quantified ; non-compliant = no optimization identified
actions_audit: Request the quantified cost optimization plan, including AI inference costs where applicable; attach the document.
Verify the implementation status of the priority optimizations (model routing, caching, compression); document the progress.
If a gap is found: identify and quantify the missing optimizations, then prioritize their implementation.

controls.regle: FinOps maturity is declared capability by capability (e.g. allocation, forecasting, spend optimization, AI inference optimization) on the Crawl/Walk/Run scale, for each significant spend perimeter (public cloud, SaaS, licenses, AI/inference) — never a single overall maturity score that hides gaps between capabilities.
controls.verification: Request the maturity declaration by capability and by spend perimeter (Crawl/Walk/Run); verify that no single overall score replaces this granularity and that every significant spend perimeter is covered.
controls.preuve_attendue: Maturity grid by capability and by spend perimeter, dated, with a justification of the level declared for each.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = maturity declared by capability for all significant perimeters, with justification ; partial = partial declaration or overall score without detail by capability ; non-compliant = no maturity declaration
actions_audit: Request the maturity grid by capability and by spend perimeter; attach the document.
Verify that the granularity by capability is respected (no overall score hiding it) and that the significant perimeters (cloud, SaaS, licenses, AI) are covered.
If a gap is found: produce the missing maturity grid by capability, or break down an existing overall score.
standards: FinOps Foundation — FinOps Framework 2025/2026 (Scopes, maturité Crawl/Walk/Run par capacité)

controls.regle: Hosting and sizing decisions document their environmental impact at least qualitatively (choice of region, scheduled shutdown, sizing as close as possible to the actual need); a quantitative measure (e.g. Software Carbon Intensity) is adopted as soon as a technology profile exposes one in a verifiable way.
controls.verification: Verify that the cost optimization plan (CTL-D07-07) also documents the qualitative environmental impact of the choices made, and that a quantitative measure is used if a technology profile exposes one.
controls.preuve_attendue: Environmental section of the optimization plan, or a dedicated document, documenting the choices (region, shutdown, sizing) and their qualitative justification — quantitative measure attached if available.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = environmental impact documented qualitatively for the significant choices (+ quantitative measure if a profile exposes one) ; partial = informal mention without structured documentation ; non-compliant = no documented environmental consideration
actions_audit: Request the environmental section of the cost optimization plan or the dedicated document; attach the reference.
Verify the qualitative justification of the region/shutdown/sizing choices and the presence of a quantitative measure if a profile exposes one.
If a gap is found: document the missing qualitative environmental impact of the hosting decisions.
standards: Green Software Foundation — Software Carbon Intensity (SCI)
